videos.desc: In a cabin a woman clicks a dead flashlight, unscrews it and tips out the old batteries; she and her friend compare them with fresh ones, load the new batteries in, and the flashlight lights up the table as they cheer.

In a cozy evening living room a man unscrews the dead bulb from a small table lamp, takes a new bulb out of its cardboard box, screws it in, and the lamp glows warmly while his partner watches from the sofa with tea and the cat looks on.

A woman panics dramatically because her phone battery is dying; a man digs a white charger out of a messy drawer, plugs it into the wall socket and connects the phone, and they relax on the sofa giving a thumbs up as it charges.

In a wooden cabin kitchen, a woman pulls open the bottom freezer drawer of a fridge and icy mist pours out, making her gasp 'You can see the cold!'. She lifts out a rock-solid bag of frozen peas, a man taps a tub of ice cream with a spoon, and they show a bag of frost-covered berries before closing the drawer.
videos.said: Look! You can see the cold! Rock solid!

videos.desc: A girl in a kitchen puts on big white headphones and dances while singing into a wooden spoon; her friend tries to talk to her but she shouts that she can't hear him, then holds one earcup to his ear so they can listen together.
videos.said: Can't hear you! One for you!

videos.desc: Late at night, a young couple slides a plate of leftovers into a silver microwave, turns the dial and presses their faces close to watch the food spin, counting down until the ding. He pulls the plate out and immediately shovels in a steaming forkful while she laughs.
videos.said: Spin little dinner! Three, two, one! Ding! It's time!

videos.desc: On a rooftop terrace at dusk, a phone rings on a wooden table while two young women drink tea; one grabs it excitedly, answers the call and paces around chatting happily with her hand pressed to her cheek.

A couple's floor lamp goes dark, and they frown and investigate. Following the cable, they find the white two-pin plug lying loose on the floor, hold it up to the camera saying "Well, there's why", then push it into the wall socket and the lamp lights up again.
videos.said: Well, there's why. Let there be light!

videos.desc: A couple opens their new empty refrigerator, enjoys the cold air, then fills the shelves with milk bottles, leafy greens, eggs and cheese before proudly posing beside the closed fridge.
videos.said: Cold air heaven! All of it fresh!

videos.desc: An animated young man in a desert diner holds up a tablet and draws on its white screen with his finger, sketching a cactus that fills in green, then leans back happily comparing his drawing with the real cactus outside the window.

Two men lower bread slices into a stainless-steel toaster, turn its dial and lean in nose-to-nose, staring dead-serious at the glowing slots until the toast pops high into the air; one snatches a slice from the air and they grin and bite into their toast.
videos.said: Down and glow. Pop! Cut it!

videos.desc: In a cozy attic room at dusk, an animated girl with round glasses pulls the cord of the hanging light bulb so it goes dark, then presses the button on a standing fan and its blades spin to a stop. She smiles, satisfied, by the darkened window.

In a library, a young woman hammers away at a laptop keyboard at absurd speed while the guy next to her watches with his jaw dropping. Her fingers fly over the keys, he asks how she is that fast, and she throws her arms up in triumph when she finishes.
videos.said: How are you that fast? And done.

videos.desc: In a bright open-plan office a desktop monitor shows a colorful marketing dashboard with charts, and a hand reaches in and points at the screen while someone works at the keyboard.

A bored young woman scoops ice cubes into a glass kettle and switches it on to melt them, watching until the ice turns to water. She celebrates, then pours the little jug of melted water into a huge swimming pool.

A kitchen with white cupboards and a dark polished wooden floor. A tall stainless steel fridge with a double door, an ice and water dispenser in the left-hand door and a freezer drawer underneath stands against the wall, and a raised metal dog bowl in a wooden stand sits next to it. A man in pink pyjamas crouches down on the floor in front of the fridge next to a golden retriever that is lying there, strokes its back and talks to it. He goes down onto his knees, then lies right down on the floor with his arms round the dog and his head against it, while a second golden retriever lies stretched out on the floor in the foreground.

A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

A woman in a white shirt aims a cordless drill at a wall while a man in a blue polo holds a spirit level against a black bracket and then reaches up towards the ceiling. The two of them carry a large black screen across the room, hang it on the wall and switch it on, and it lights up in strong blue. In the last shot the room is dark and a wall of nine mounted screens glows bright blue, lighting up both of their faces and the plastic sheet spread over the floor.

An older woman in a patchwork apron fills a stainless steel electric kettle from the kitchen tap, then sets it back on its round base on the worktop, where a red light comes on and it starts to boil. She carries it to a wooden table where five brightly patterned mugs stand in a row, each with a teabag in it, and pours the boiling water into one mug after another.

Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.

At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.

At a café window seat, a young blonde woman in a white sleeveless top and a black skirt sits on a stool at the wooden counter, calmly taps on her phone, then puts it face down on the counter, turns away and picks up a croissant. Outside, on the other side of the glass, a man with curly hair in a blue denim shirt holds up his own phone, waves and then stands frowning at her. A cappuccino, a croissant and a second phone sit on the counter, plants hang in the window and people sit at a table behind her.

In a busy airport departure lounge, a young woman in a grey hoodie kneels on the carpet next to a charging pillar and laughs as she holds up her phone, plugged in by a white cable. The red battery symbol on the screen turns green, and she makes a happy fist. Next to her a tired man in a grey suit and tie leans against the pillar with his eyes half closed. Cables, a spilled coffee cup, a neck pillow and bags lie on the floor, and a departures board hangs behind.

In a small shop on a hot day with bright light pouring through the open door, a young woman in a white shirt and linen trousers sits cross-legged on the cracked concrete floor in front of an open glass-door drinks fridge, cold mist rolling out around her. She holds a cold bottle of water to her cheek and reads a book. Shelves of bottled water and cans glow inside the other fridge, and behind her people wait at the counter, one man fanning himself.

A rocky mountain summit under a deep blue sky. A young woman in a yellow jacket, black trousers and hiking boots climbs onto a boulder, stretches up and holds a mobile phone high in the air, first with one hand and then with both, her ponytail blowing sideways. A young man sits on the rocks below, laughing and eating a sandwich. A stone cairn, a backpack, trekking poles and a paper map lie on the rocks, two black birds fly past and hazy ridges stretch to the horizon.

Deep inside a dark cave with wet striped rock walls. A young man in a black jacket kneels against the rock holding a small torch with only a weak orange glow. Beside him a young woman with red braids, in a blue jacket, holds a white torch that shines brightly at first, then goes completely dark; she shakes it, looks at it and then looks at him with a worried face. The passage behind them is black. A coil of rope and a canvas backpack lie on the ground.
